sentences.en: The box had been damaged, but its contents were intact.
sentences.zh: 这个盒子虽然受损了，但里面的东西完好无损。

sentences.en: In archaeology, it is important to keep findings intact and undamaged.
sentences.zh: 在考古学中，保持发现完整且未受损非常重要。

sentences.en: Kabyles have managed to keep their Muslim faith intact for centuries.
sentences.zh: 凯比尔人成功地保持他们的伊斯兰信仰几百年来没有改变。

senses.zh: 完整无缺的, 尚未被人碰过的, (女子)保持童贞的, (家畜)未经阉割的。
